name: EveryDollar
description: EveryDollar is a zero-based budgeting app from Ramsey Solutions for planning monthly income, expenses, savings, and debt payments. Households use it to assign every dollar a purpose, track transactions, and monitor progress against a personal budget.
agentUseSummary: EveryDollar does not publish a supported third-party account API, so Relay does not collect Ramsey credentials, automate private clients, or expose agent actions.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is offered without a provider-supported third-party API contract.

providerSetup.blocker: EveryDollar's official product and support surfaces do not publish a developer application, delegated authorization flow, account API, or webhook contract for third-party access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if EveryDollar publishes an official third-party developer program and documented authorization and account-data APIs.

evidence.supports: Ramsey Solutions presents EveryDollar as a consumer zero-based budgeting product with transaction tracking and planning, not a third-party developer platform.
The official EveryDollar help center documents customer product workflows and support but does not publish developer authorization, scopes, APIs, webhooks, or application registration.
Ramsey Solutions' terms govern use of its consumer services and do not establish a Relay-compatible third-party account API contract.
